resources.string: The pinned list changed. Try moving the station again.
Saved radio settings are invalid. Safe defaults are being used; review Radio settings.

Pinned stations stay in their groups and also appear as shortcuts. Their names and pin icons use this color. The default is yellow in dark mode and amber in light mode. Use Default restores theme-aware colors; custom colors stay the same in both themes.
The %1$d shortcut slots are full. Unpin a station before pinning another.
No pinned stations. Open Radio, hold a channel and choose Pin.
A station can have up to 32 different addresses. No changes were saved.
This source failed. Trying source %1$d/%2$d for the same station.
Audio URLs, one per line (HTTP is unencrypted)
Station saved. An unchanged playing source continues without reconnecting.
Remove all current stations before importing?

Keep and merge: keep all current stations and addresses. Match by station name or a known ID; skip the same source URL and add a different URL as another playing source. New names become new stations.

Replace all stations: remove the current list and keep ONLY valid station/source entries from the file, including when built-ins are missing. Old addresses not in the file are removed. This choice survives restarts and backups; Reset built-ins can restore the bundled stations. Pins remain only for retained station IDs.

The original file, local music, music playlists and downloaded logo files are not deleted. An unchanged playing source continues; replacing or removing that source pauses radio. Cancel leaves everything unchanged.

A larger buffer can absorb short interruptions but increases live delay and memory use. HLS stations with short live windows may supply less than the target; the player adjusts its starting threshold to avoid waiting forever. Radio audio allocation is limited to about 8 MiB plus decoder/network overhead. Audio is held in memory only, not recorded. New live-delay and retry settings take full effect on the next Play or source switch. Local-file buffering is unchanged.

Retries are bounded per failed request; unavailable or forbidden URLs are not repeatedly retried. Automatic source switching is off by default. When on, each address of the same station is tried at most once per Play attempt, then playback stops. It never skips to another station. Stop or returning to music cancels recovery; hiding the Radio panel does not.
Remove all downloaded radio logos? Stations, addresses, pins, music and lyrics will not be changed. Logos download again on a later playback when enabled. Audio has no persistent disk cache.
Cached radio logos cleared. Stations and playback were kept.
The station logo could not be downloaded. Audio is unaffected; the generic icon is shown.
A cached radio logo could not be read. Clear radio logos in Radio settings to download it again.
Show receive speed and audio buffer

Playing shows the source number and host, recent received bytes per second, and seconds of playable audio ahead. This is measured stream traffic, not a network speed test or a guarantee against interruptions. HLS downloads arrive in bursts, so 0 KB/s while buffered audio plays is normal. Status refreshes once per second only while Playing is visible. Remote logos are downloaded while listening or through Download all pinned station logos, kept on disk until cleared, and decoded with a small memory cache. Bundled marks need no download. Browsing never fetches logos.
